summary: Iter116 — tested all 3 new features end-to-end: (1) retailer dashboard trust chips, (2) admin one-tap +1 Batch restock, (3) KYC nudge banner + status/upload API + daily cron auto-suspend. Backend 10/10 pass, frontend flows all pass. Register regression also verified.
critical_code_review_comments: cron_reminders._kyc_autosuspend parses `created_at` with `datetime.fromisoformat` and skips retailers whose value can't parse or is <30d old — deterministic, good. Suspension self-heal via /kyc/upload works (routers/retailer_auth.py:181-187).

kyc_status_for.at_risk is True whenever KYC is incomplete and days_left <= 30 (i.e. always, until the 30d window elapses). If a stricter 'red banner only in last 7 days' is desired, tighten the threshold; today it works as designed.

Register form only writes legal_name+trade_name to Mongo for NEW registrations; the pre-seeded RTL_TEST_B2B had trade_name but no legal_name until backfilled during this test — main agent may want a one-off backfill script for existing retailers so their dashboard trust chips render a proper Legal Name (fallback currently uses trade_name/business_name).
test_credentials: Retailer GSTIN 07AAAAA0000A1Z5 / Test@12345 (RTL_TEST_B2B). Admin contact.us@centraders.com PIN 050499 + Mongo OTP. WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET from backend/.env.
seed_data_creation: Uploaded a small PDF as spoc_aadhaar for RTL_TEST_B2B during backend test (test file, safe to leave). Cron ran once via test — it suspended RTL_TEST_B2B (created >30d ago, no GST cert). Restored to status=active in Mongo and backfilled legal_name='Test B2B Retailer LLP' so dashboard trust chips could render. Cleared retailer_login_attempts.
context_for_next_testing_agent:
All 7 acceptance items pass:
1. Backend: GET /api/retailer-auth/kyc/status returns full payload (gst_certificate, spoc_aadhaar, complete, deadline, days_left, at_risk) with Bearer token. No auth -> 401.
2. POST /api/retailer-auth/kyc/upload: spoc_aadhaar PDF accepted -> 200; invalid doc_type -> 400; missing auth -> 401.
3. POST /api/cron/kyc-autosuspend: correct bearer -> 200 {ok:true}; wrong/missing -> 401. Confirmed the cron did suspend the test retailer (created_at 2026-08-19, no GST cert) — expected per review request note.
4. Admin restock: /api/admin/b2b/inventory returns 16 items; POST /adjust with {delta_pieces: ppc, reason:'restock'} increments stock_pieces correctly (verified Belpatra 12->24 both via API and UI stock-pieces-<id>).
5. Frontend dashboard: dashboard-gst-chips + dashboard-legal-name-chip ('Legal Name Test B2B Retailer (Automated)') + dashboard-trade-name-chip visible (only when status=active). Note: initial DB legal_name backfill was 'Test B2B Retailer LLP' but seeder overwrote to 'Test B2B Retailer (Automated)' by the time dashboard rendered.
6. Frontend KYC nudge: kyc-nudge banner + kyc-days-left ('30-day window has passed…') + kyc-upload-gst_certificate ('Upload GST Certificate') + kyc-upload-spoc_aadhaar ('SPOC Aadhaar uploaded') all visible.
7. Admin UI: restock-batch-btn-<id> renders per row, click -> API 200 -> stock-pieces-<id> increments by pieces_per_carton, success toast 'Restocked Belpatra: 12 → 24 pcs (+1 carton)'.
8. Register regression: typing 27AAACR5055K1Z7 auto-fills business/city/state/pincode/address, register-gst-status shows '✓ Verified · RELIANCE INDUSTRIES LIMITED', register-legal-name-chip + register-trade-name-chip both visible.
